notes.title: Discord For Beta Testing
notes.content:
We have waited patiently for unreal engine 5's release!
Now that it's here we can finally start working on the release of new era.

But we will need your help, as we are working on new map generation, character creation, and overall gameplay/enhancements!

Will you join us in being helpful?

[url=https://discord.com/invite/nzxnAx7qQh]Join our discord server![/url]
